hair:
Transparent game sprite atlas for ONE hairstyle only. Rework the first hairstyle from image1 to match image2's SIMPLE painted ink robe style. Output THREE separated hair-only pieces in ONE HORIZONTAL ROW, equal square cells, on true transparent background. Column1: FRONT HAIR as seen from FRONT (soft centre part with V opening and two face-framing locks, empty face hole). Column2: REAR HAIR as seen from FRONT (small half-up bun, wooden pin, continuous hidden scalp and wavy long rear hair). Column3: the SAME REAR HAIR as seen from BACK. No side views, no other hairstyles, no faces/skin/ears/body. The front and rear are independently replaceable layers. Preserve first style's overall proportions.
CRITICAL: ALL THREE pieces use the EXACT SAME BLACK hair palette, neutral ink-black #272b2a base, near-black #161c19 contour/shadows, low-contrast charcoal #414743 light wash. NO brown hair, NO blond/gray masses, NO silver highlights. The only brown element is the small wooden hairpin. Broader simplified hair clumps, just a few readable flowing contours, very faint paper grain. Matte, restrained 2–3 value groups matching the robe's illustrative simplicity; no glossy wig, no photoreal fine strands. Keep each complete piece unclipped with transparent gutters, front-hair piece similar skull width to the rear pieces. No text/labels/grid/ground glow.
field: Create a finished 2D game battlefield BACKGROUND for a small Chinese ink-and-watercolour chibi RPG, matching the approved ivory-blue robe reference image's clean simplified hand-painted style. Wide 16:10 landscape, gently elevated top-down game camera, essentially flat orthographic walkable ground. A quiet old martial training clearing: broad pale warm-gray weathered stone/sandy courtyard in the centre, sparse soft grass at the perimeter, low irregular dark rocks and small bamboo clusters mostly confined to far left/right and top margins, hints of distant misty ink mountains at the very top edge. Muted jade gray, parchment beige, charcoal outlines, restrained wash and subtle paper grain, a few broad readable shapes. The middle 75% MUST be open continuous bright low-contrast walkable ground, no obstacles, no dark busy texture. No people, animals, dummies, weapons, buildings in middle, no stairs or paths dividing the floor. No UI, labels, borders, text, cursors, prepainted player shadows. Ground should support game characters above it, not a scenic horizon painting. Soft diffused even daylight, no photoreal detail or glossy 3D.
field_perspective:

Fix inconsistent perspective: this is a fixed oblique ORTHOGRAPHIC game arena viewed mildly from above, with NO horizon, NO distant mountains, NO sky, NO shrinking distant objects, NO scenic landscape vista. The ENTIRE canvas is one continuous walkable ground plane. Keep the clean pale warm gray/cream ink-watercolour palette and broad low-contrast central clearing. Replace the upper mountains/sky band with more continuous ground extending beyond the top edge. Sparse short bamboo and low rocks ONLY at perimeter/corners, viewed at the same slight downward angle and consistent size, with small flat contact shadows. Central 80% clear and readable, very few broad stone patches; no foreground terrace, steps, fences or walls. Hand-painted simplified ink outline and soft wash match the approved chibi robe: moderate detail, no photoreal terrain, no thick watercolor noise. Wide 16:10. No ground characters, dummies, labels, game UI, graphic frame.
field_ink_revision: Use case: style-transfer. Edit the supplied game battlefield background. This is a Chinese ink-wash martial cultivation game, NOT a cartoon or a cute toy world. Preserve the broad open central playing space and the fixed shallow oblique orthographic ground angle, with NO horizon or sky. Repaint the environment with mature restrained ink-and-light-colour brushwork: naturally irregular rough stones with dry-brush broken silhouettes, subtle ink pools and soft pigment bleeding, fine spare bamboo leaves using confident brush strokes, sparse irregular grasses. Remove the thick uniform enclosing outlines, the smooth rounded toy-like rocks, the repetitive star-shaped grass tufts, and the symmetrical sticker-like arrangement. Keep all objects at the outer margins; central 80% is unobstructed continuous light ground with very subtle irregular mineral/sand washes. Ground is pale warm gray with a little paper warmth, rocks neutral ink gray, bamboo muted gray-green; avoid overly yellow parchment. Recognisable terrain and grounded contact washes, not an empty paper texture. Do not introduce mountains, distance scaling, buildings, characters, dummies, text, UI or a graphic frame. Large broad values with a few readable brush details, no photorealistic surface noise, no glossy 3D shading, no vector outlines. Canvas landscape around 16:10, same background purpose and camera projection as input. Output only the finished battlefield background.
